questions.question: Which courses are "the technical courses identified in Footnote 1" for admission? The captured requirement table has no footnotes, so neither the 2.50 grade point nor the C grades can be checked.

The program says every B.S.Ch.E. concentration is 6 credits of technical electives, and the Semiconductor Manufacturing description says the same, but its requirements name CHEM 311, ECE 371 and CBE 412 (9 credits). Which is it, and do the extra 3 credits count toward the 15 additional credits?

The concentrations list 500-level courses (for example BIOL 592, BME 575, CBE 512) beside 400-level ones. May an undergraduate count a 500-level course, and is a 400/500 pair (CBE 412 and CBE 512) one choice or two?
